title: Oven Roasted Syrian Lentil Pilaf
description: A comforting Syrian dish featuring yellow curry paste and a blend of spices, roasted to perfection in a slate tile vessel.

ingredients.name: lentils
ingredients.notes: green or brown lentils work well

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lentils, yellow curry paste, olive oil, onion, garlic, tandoor spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a slate tile vessel and roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
While the lentil mixture is roasting, prepare the eggs by beating them in a small bowl.
After the lentil mixture has roasted for 30 minutes, remove it from the oven and create 2 wells in the mixture.
Pour the beaten eggs into the wells and return the vessel to the oven.
Continue to roast for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the lentils are tender.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
